what_it_does: Zagreb-based Croatian arm of the Dun & Bradstreet group (Jacksonville, Florida) supplying businesses with data, indicators, assessments and analytical models on customers, suppliers and partners, including creditworthiness ratings of Croatian companies.
notes: Its Croatian privacy notice on dnb.com says the d.o.o. is part of the Dun & Bradstreet corporation headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida; AmCham says D&B has operated in Croatia since 2021 and lists its industry as consulting, though the offering described is business data and analytics.

what_it_does: Indian full-service law firm, now listed as CMS INDUSLAW, founded in 2000 in Bangalore with offices in Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad and Mumbai, ranked by Chambers in corporate, M&A, banking, employment, tax, disputes and IP.
notes: Chambers, Legal 500 and asialaw list it as CMS INDUSLAW; one listing calls it an Indian member of CMS, an international organisation of independent law firms. AP name has no legal form or city, so the match rests on the exact name and the payer's India presence.
